propositions: External integration suite exercises only one live provider (Anthropic) in CI instead of covering all credentialed providers (Anthropic, Bedrock, OpenAI), creating blind spots for provider-specific regressions.

Provider selection must become an explicit matrix dimension in CI workflows using REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE to set [llm.model_classes], with each arm skipping loudly when its credential is absent rather than silently succeeding.

Bedrock authentication must use OIDC role assumption via aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials on GitHub-hosted runners, with explicit AWS_DEFAULT_REGION and REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION environment variables to prevent NoRegionError failures.

Config overlay merging was incomplete: cfg.model still resolved to DEFAULT_MODEL (claude-opus-4-8) instead of the provider-qualified model from the overlay, causing non-Anthropic arms to silently call Anthropic.

Test assertions pinned the wrong surface: test_each_overlay_sets_only_the_model_classes_table forbade the model key that the fix required, and test_every_model_class_resolves_to_the_declared_provider never checked cfg.model itself.
Per-provider live test execution was verified across all three arms with canary metrics confirming genuine test execution rather than vacuous skips or silent fallbacks.
